```{r setup, include=FALSE}
knitr::opts_chunk$set(echo = TRUE)
```

```{r}

modello_i <- "FinalMay/tmean_10_90_sincos"

# --------------------------------------------------------------------------

# create folder for results 

results_path <- file.path(paste0("results/for_publication_2/", modello_i))
dir_out_res_desc <-  file.path(paste0("results/descriptive/", modello_i))

dir.create(results_path, recursive = T, showWarnings = F)
dir.create(dir_out_res_desc, recursive = T, showWarnings = F)

# --------------------------------------------------------------------------

# Labels for ecoregions names

label_name_eco_eng = c( # now cross checked with the whole thing 
  "1A" = "Alpine Chain",
  "1B" = "Po Valley",
  "1C" = "Apennine Chain",
  "2B" = "Tyrrhenian Coast and the Islands", 
  "2C" = "Apulia and the Adriatic Coast"
)


label_name_eco_eng_facet = c( # now cross checked with the whole thing 
  "1A" = "Alpine Chain",
  "1B" = "Po Valley",
  "1C" = "Apennine Chain",
  "2B" = "Tyrrhenian Coast\nand the Islands", 
  "2C" = "Apulia and the\nAdriatic Coast"
)




# Extract models 

shapefile_comuni$Ecoregioni %>% unique()-> ecoregioni_names #EC is this correct?
ecoregioni_names<- c("1B", "1A", "1C", "2B", "2C")

overall_ris <- list()
for (eco in ecoregioni_names) {
  
  overall_ris[[eco]] <- readRDS(
    file = file.path(
                     modello_i, #Replace here with whatever different result
                     paste0("res_", eco, ".rds"))
  )
}

```

##Fixed effects

### Extract linear effects of year (long-term time trend) and employment rate 

Tables

```{r}

purrr::map(overall_ris, ~ .x$fixed["EMPL_RATE_20_64", ] %>% 
             round(4)
           ) %>% 
  dplyr::bind_rows(.id = "eco") %>% 
  mutate(
    eco_code = eco,                        # <-- keep original code
    eco      = label_name_eco_eng[eco]     # <-- recode to full label
  ) %>% 
  mutate(
    `95% CrI` = paste0("(", `0.025quant`, " - ", `0.975quant`, ")")
  ) %>% 
  rename(Ecoregion = eco, 
         RR = mean) %>% 
  select(Ecoregion, RR, `95% CrI`) %>% 
  remove_rownames() %>% 
    knitr::kable(format = "latex", booktabs = TRUE)



purrr::map(overall_ris, ~ .x$fixed["year_number", ] %>% 
             round(4)
           ) %>% 
  dplyr::bind_rows(.id = "eco") %>% 
  mutate(
    eco_code = eco,                        # <-- keep original code
    eco      = label_name_eco_eng[eco]     # <-- recode to full label
  ) %>% 
  mutate(
    `95% CrI` = paste0("(", `0.025quant`, " - ", `0.975quant`, ")")
  ) %>% 
  rename(Ecoregion = eco, 
         RR = mean) %>% 
  select(Ecoregion, RR, `95% CrI`) %>% 
  remove_rownames() %>% 
    knitr::kable(format = "latex", booktabs = TRUE)


```

## Shapefile and ecological region partition
For computational purposes, the analysis was stratified by 5 Ecological macro-regions. 

```{r}

shapefile_comuni %>% 
  group_by(Ecoregioni) %>% 
  summarise(geometry = st_union(geometry)) %>% 
  ggplot() +
  geom_sf(aes(fill = Ecoregioni)) +
  labs(fill = "Ecological Region") +
  theme_void() +
  theme(
    legend.text = element_text(size=14), 
    legend.title = element_blank()) +
  scale_fill_discrete(labels = label_name_eco_eng) -> map_ecoregions


ggsave(plot = map_ecoregions, 
       filename = paste0(results_path, "/map_ecoregions.png"), 
       width = 8,
       height = 4,
       units = "in",
       dpi = 300)
  
map_ecoregions

```




## Model specification


 
```{r}
knots_list <- lapply(names(overall_ris), function(nm) {
  overall_ris[[nm]]$dlnm_tmax$var_knots
})
names(knots_list) <- names(overall_ris)


knots_list %>%
  enframe(name = "model", value = "var_knots") %>%
  mutate(var_knots = lapply(var_knots, function(x) {
    tibble(
      knot_name = names(x),
      var_knots = as.numeric(x)
    )
  })) %>%
  unnest(var_knots) %>% 
  mutate(var_knots = round(var_knots, 2)) %>%
  pivot_wider(
    names_from = knot_name,
    values_from = var_knots
) %>%
    knitr::kable(format = "latex", booktabs = TRUE)


```


# Model outcome

## Seasonal trend 


```{r}
bind_cols(lapply(overall_ris,
                 function(m) m[["fixed"]]["sin_i", "mean"]*as.numeric(scale(sin((2*pi*1:53)/53))) + m[["fixed"]]["cos_i", "mean"]*as.numeric(scale(cos((2*pi*1:53)/53)))) %>% 
            bind_rows() %>% 
            mutate(week = 1:53) %>% 
            pivot_longer(cols =all_of( ecoregioni_names), values_to = "RR"),
          lapply(overall_ris,
                 function(m) m[["fixed"]]["sin_i", "0.025quant"]*as.numeric(scale(sin((2*pi*1:53)/53))) + m[["fixed"]]["cos_i", "0.025quant"]*as.numeric(scale(cos((2*pi*1:53)/53)))) %>% 
            bind_rows() %>% 
            mutate(week = 1:53) %>% 
            pivot_longer(cols =all_of( ecoregioni_names), values_to = "RR_u") %>% 
            select(-c(week, name)),
          lapply(overall_ris,
                 function(m) m[["fixed"]]["sin_i", "0.975quant"]*as.numeric(scale(sin((2*pi*1:53)/53))) + m[["fixed"]]["cos_i", "0.975quant"]*as.numeric(scale(cos((2*pi*1:53)/53)))) %>% 
            bind_rows() %>% 
            mutate(week = 1:53) %>% 
            pivot_longer(cols =all_of( ecoregioni_names), values_to = "RR_l")%>% 
            select(-c(week, name))) %>% 
  mutate(RR_exp = exp(RR), 
         RR_l_exp = exp(RR_l),
         RR_u_exp = exp(RR_u)) %>% 
ggplot(aes(x = week,
           y = RR_exp,
           ymin = RR_l_exp,
           ymax = RR_u_exp,
           linetype =name)) +
  geom_line() +
  geom_ribbon(alpha = .2) +
  theme_minimal() +
  theme(legend.position = "bottom") +
    scale_x_continuous(breaks = 1 + seq(1, 53, by = (53/12)), 
                     labels = str_month_names, 
                     limits = c(1,53)) +
  labs(x = "Month",
       y = "RR (95% CrI)", 
       fill = "Ecological Region") +
    theme(
#    axis.text.x.bottom =  element_text(size=16),
    axis.title.x.bottom = element_text(size=16),
    axis.title.y.left = element_text(size=16),
    axis.text.y = element_text(size = 16),
    axis.text.x = element_text(size = 16),
    #strip.text = element_text(size = 14), 
    legend.text = element_text(size = 18)
  ) +
  geom_hline(aes(yintercept = 1), linetype = "dashed")+
  guides(fill = "none", 
         linetype = guide_legend(nrow = 2, title = NULL)) +
  scale_linetype_discrete(labels = label_name_eco_eng, name = "Ecological Region") -> seasonality

seasonality

ggsave(
  filename = "seasonality.png",
  path = results_path,
  plot = seasonality,
  width = 12,
  height = 7,
  dpi = 300
  )

seasonality

```



## Maps: Conception/birth rate 

### Posterior probability that the RR is greater than one (P(RR)>1)
```{r}

bind_rows(shp_list) %>% 
  mutate(RR = lapply(overall_ris,
                     function(m) m$prob_gt1[1:(nrow(m$id_space)/2)]) %>% 
           unlist()) %>% 
   mutate(RR_cat = cut(RR,
                      breaks = c(0, 0.25, 0.5, 0.75, 1),
                      labels = c("<0.25", "0.25–0.5","0.5–0.75",  "0.75+"),
                      right = FALSE)) %>% 
  ggplot()+
  geom_sf(aes(fill = RR_cat), color = NA)+
  scale_fill_viridis_d(name = "P(RR)>1")+
  theme_void() +
  theme(
  legend.text = element_text(size = 16),   
  legend.title = element_text(size = 18),  
  legend.position = "bottom"
  )+
  geom_sf(data = shapefile_comuni %>% 
            group_by(COD_REG)%>% 
            summarise(geometry = st_union(geometry)),
          fill = NA, color = "red") -> plot_map_pp


ggsave(
  filename = "map_PP.png",
  path = results_path,
  plot = plot_map_pp,
  width = 10,
  height = 8,
  dpi = 300)



```

### Relative Risk of birth relative to the national mean
```{r}
bind_rows(shp_list) %>% 
  mutate(RR = lapply(overall_ris,
                     function(m) exp(m[["id_space"]][["mean"]][1:(nrow(m$id_space)/2)])) %>% 
           unlist()) %>% 
  mutate(RR_cat = cut(RR,
             breaks = c(-Inf, 0.25, 0.5, 0.75, 1, 1.25, 1.5, 1.75, Inf),
             labels = c("<0.25", "0.25–0.50", "0.50–0.75", "0.75–1.00", "1.00–1.25", "1.25–1.50", "1.50-1.75", "1.75+"),
             right = FALSE)) %>% 
  ggplot()+
  geom_sf(aes(fill = RR_cat), color = NA)+
  theme_void()+
    theme(
  legend.text = element_text(size = 16),   
  legend.title = element_text(size = 18),  
  legend.position = "bottom"
  )+
  scale_fill_viridis_d(name = "RR") -> plot_map_rr



ggsave(
  filename = "map_RR.png",
  path = results_path,
  plot = plot_map_rr,
  width = 10,
  height = 8,
  dpi = 300)


```


# Model Results 

## Effect of temperature on birth rates

### Table: Overall effect of temperature over 3-22 GW on birth rates by decile of temperature and Ecoregion 
```{r}

purrr::map(
  overall_ris,
  ~ extract_overall_exposure_effect(
    cp  = fn_make_cp(.x),
    eco = .x$ecoregione
  )) %>% bind_rows() %>%
  group_by(eco) %>%
  mutate(
    perc_10 = quantile(temp, probs = 0.10, na.rm = TRUE),
    perc_20 = quantile(temp, probs = 0.20, na.rm = TRUE),
    perc_30 = quantile(temp, probs = 0.30, na.rm = TRUE),
    perc_40 = quantile(temp, probs = 0.40, na.rm = TRUE),
    perc_50 = quantile(temp, probs = 0.50, na.rm = TRUE),
    perc_60 = quantile(temp, probs = 0.60, na.rm = TRUE),
    perc_70 = quantile(temp, probs = 0.70, na.rm = TRUE),
    perc_80 = quantile(temp, probs = 0.80, na.rm = TRUE),
    perc_90 = quantile(temp, probs = 0.90, na.rm = TRUE)
  ) %>%
  pivot_longer(
    cols      = starts_with("perc_"),
    names_to  = "percentile",
    values_to = "temp_at_perc"
  ) %>%

  filter(
        temp == temp_at_perc) %>% 
mutate(
    RR    = round(RR, 4), 
    RR_l  = round(RR_l, 4), 
    RR_u  = round(RR_u, 4),
    eco   = label_name_eco_eng[eco],
    `95% CrI` = paste0("(", RR_l, " - ", RR_u, ")")
  ) %>% 
    mutate(percentile = as.integer(str_remove(percentile, "perc_"))) %>% 
  arrange(eco) %>%
  select(-c(RR_l, RR_u, temp_at_perc)) %>% 
  rename(Temperature = temp,
         Ecoregion = eco
         ) %>% 
  mutate(
    Ecoregion = ifelse(duplicated(Ecoregion), "", Ecoregion)
  ) %>% 
  select(Ecoregion, percentile, Temperature, RR, `95% CrI`) %>%
  knitr::kable(format = "latex", booktabs = TRUE)
purrr::map(
```

### Tables: Effect of temperature on conception by GW group (3-4, 5-9, 10-16, 17-22 )

```{r}
# % change (for graphical abstract)

start_lag <- 1 
end_lag   <- 5
  
purrr::map(
    overall_ris,
    ~ extract_RR_by_gw_group(
      cp       = fn_make_cp(.x),
      eco      = .x$ecoregione,
      start_gw = start_lag,
      end_gw   = end_lag
    )
  ) %>%
    dplyr::bind_rows() %>%
    dplyr::mutate(lag_window = paste0("Lag ", (start_lag+2), "-", (end_lag+2) )) %>%
  dplyr::group_by(lag_window, eco) %>%
        group_by(eco) %>%
  mutate(
    perc_10 = quantile(temp, probs = 0.10, na.rm = TRUE),
 #   perc_20 = quantile(temp, probs = 0.20, na.rm = TRUE),
 #   perc_30 = quantile(temp, probs = 0.30, na.rm = TRUE),
 #   perc_40 = quantile(temp, probs = 0.40, na.rm = TRUE),
 #   perc_50 = quantile(temp, probs = 0.50, na.rm = TRUE),
 #   perc_60 = quantile(temp, probs = 0.60, na.rm = TRUE),
 #   perc_70 = quantile(temp, probs = 0.70, na.rm = TRUE),
 #   perc_80 = quantile(temp, probs = 0.80, na.rm = TRUE),
 #   perc_90 = quantile(temp, probs = 0.90, na.rm = TRUE)
  ) %>%
  pivot_longer(
    cols      = starts_with("perc_"),
    names_to  = "percentile",
    values_to = "temp_at_perc"
  ) %>%
  filter(temp == temp_at_perc) %>% 
  mutate(
    pct_change   = round((RR   - 1) * 100, 2),
    pct_change_l = round((RR_l - 1) * 100, 2),
    pct_change_u = round((RR_u - 1) * 100, 2),
    eco          = label_name_eco_eng[eco],
    `95% CrI`    = paste0("(", pct_change_l, "% - ", pct_change_u, "%)")
  ) %>%
  mutate(percentile = as.integer(str_remove(percentile, "perc_"))) %>% 
  arrange(eco) %>%
  rename(
    Temperature    = temp,
    Ecoregion      = eco,
    `% Change`     = pct_change
  ) %>% 
  mutate(
    Ecoregion = ifelse(duplicated(Ecoregion), "", Ecoregion)
  ) %>%
  select(-c(pct_change_l, pct_change_u)) %>% 
  remove_rownames() %>% View()
  select(Ecoregion, percentile, Temperature, `% Change`, `95% CrI`)


```




```{r}

# RR
start_lag <- 16 
end_lag   <- 19
  
purrr::map(
    overall_ris,
    ~ extract_RR_by_gw_group(
      cp       = fn_make_cp(.x),
      eco      = .x$ecoregione,
      start_gw = start_lag,
      end_gw   = end_lag
    )
  ) %>%
    dplyr::bind_rows() %>%
    dplyr::mutate(lag_window = paste0("Lag ", (start_lag+2), "-", (end_lag+2) )) %>%
  dplyr::group_by(lag_window, eco) %>%
        group_by(eco) %>%
  mutate(
    perc_10 = quantile(temp, probs = 0.10, na.rm = TRUE),
    perc_20 = quantile(temp, probs = 0.20, na.rm = TRUE),
    perc_30 = quantile(temp, probs = 0.30, na.rm = TRUE),
    perc_40 = quantile(temp, probs = 0.40, na.rm = TRUE),
    perc_50 = quantile(temp, probs = 0.50, na.rm = TRUE),
    perc_60 = quantile(temp, probs = 0.60, na.rm = TRUE),
    perc_70 = quantile(temp, probs = 0.70, na.rm = TRUE),
    perc_80 = quantile(temp, probs = 0.80, na.rm = TRUE),
    perc_90 = quantile(temp, probs = 0.90, na.rm = TRUE)
  ) %>%
  pivot_longer(
    cols      = starts_with("perc_"),
    names_to  = "percentile",
    values_to = "temp_at_perc"
  ) %>%
  filter(
        temp == temp_at_perc) %>% 
  mutate(
    RR    = round(RR, 4), 
    RR_l  = round(RR_l, 4), 
    RR_u  = round(RR_u, 4),
    eco   = label_name_eco_eng[eco],
    `95% CrI` = paste0("(", RR_l, " - ", RR_u, ")")  # <-- combine here
  ) %>% 
    mutate(percentile = as.integer(str_remove(percentile, "perc_"))) %>% 
  arrange(eco) %>%
  rename(Temperature = temp,
         Ecoregion = eco
         ) %>% 
          mutate(
    Ecoregion = ifelse(duplicated(Ecoregion), "", Ecoregion)
  ) %>% remove_rownames() %>% 
  select(Ecoregion, percentile, Temperature, RR, `95% CrI`) %>%
  knitr::kable(format = "latex", booktabs = TRUE)
```

### Figures: Effect of temperature on conception by GW group 


```{r}

lag_windows <- list(
  c(1, 2),
  c(3, 7),
  c(8, 18),
  c(8, 10),
  c(11, 18)
)



for (lags in lag_windows) {
  
  start_lag <- lags[1]
  end_lag   <- lags[2]
  
  
  img <- purrr::map(
    overall_ris,
    ~ extract_RR_by_gw_group(
      cp  = fn_make_cp(.x),
      eco = .x$ecoregione, 
      start_gw = start_lag, 
      end_gw = end_lag
    )
  ) %>% 
    dplyr::bind_rows() %>% 
    
    ggplot(aes(x = temp, 
               y = RR,
               group = eco )) + 
    
    geom_line(alpha = 0.8) + 
    
    geom_ribbon(aes(ymin = RR_l,
                    ymax = RR_u#,
#                    fill = factor(eco)
                    ),
                alpha = 0.2,
                colour = NA) +
    
    geom_hline(yintercept = 1, linetype = "dashed") +
    
    theme_minimal() + 
  theme(
    axis.title.x.bottom = element_text(size=16),
    axis.title.y.left = element_text(size=16),
    axis.text.x.bottom =  element_text(size = 17),
    axis.text.y.left =  element_text(size = 17),
    strip.text = element_text(size = 20)
  ) +

    labs(
    x = "Temperature (°C)", 
    y = "RR (95% CrI)"#, 
#      title = paste0("Overall exposure effect during GW ", start_lag, "-", end_lag)
    ) + 
    
    guides(fill = "none") +
    
    facet_wrap(~eco, labeller = as_labeller(label_name_eco_eng_facet), nrow=1)
  
  ggsave(
    filename = file.path(results_path, paste0("overall_lags_", (start_lag+2), "_", (end_lag+2), ".png")),
    plot  = img,
    width = 12,
    height = 5,
    dpi   = 300
    )
  img
  
  print(paste("Saving:", start_lag, end_lag, "in ", results_path))
  
}


```
